name: Scrapbot Arena
summary:
Scrapbot Arena is a top-down arena survival game in which players control a small robot fighting hostile machines. Weapons aim and fire automatically, leaving players to dodge attacks, collect scrap, and shape their build. Between waves, the workshop offers weapons and parts, while level-up choices and weapon merging provide further upgrades. Arena runs span 20 waves and include boss encounters across unlockable worlds.

The game supports solo play as well as local and online co-op for up to four players. A separate Find the Exit mode replaces open arena survival with maze-like stages and guarded exits. Players can choose from six robots and use keyboard, gamepad, or touch controls. It runs in a web browser on desktop computers, iPhone, and Android devices. Achievements, world unlocks, and leaderboards track progress, with account-based features available through the Maxcade portal.
